title: Local cross-ratio equations for inverse-limit moduli functors of Qn and Pn
author: Mark Blume; Lutz Hille
work: Quivers and moduli spaces of pointed curves of genus zero
difficulty_reason: After the named adequate-moduli and GIT prerequisites, the source-local argument must construct invariant local-ring generators for wall strata and propagate cross-ratio equations across adjacent stability polytopes. The selected proof works over arbitrary base schemes, including nonreduced ones, and reconstructs scheme-theoretic compatibility by comparing all induced local-ring homomorphisms rather than merely comparing geometric points. This functorial wall-crossing reconstruction is substantially beyond qualification-level pointwise GIT or projective cross-ratio calculations.
